claim: the legacy Python/Pemsa control path and native training smoke paths remain runnable after the native implementation

checks.name: legacy_full_suite
checks.scope: legacy control, headless, NEAT, PPO, native backend, batch, and differential tests

checks.name: native_focused_suite
checks.command: DODGE_HEADLESS=1 UV_NO_SYNC=1 devenv -q shell -- app-test -q tests/dodge/test_native_backend.py tests/dodge/test_native_batch.py tests/dodge/test_native_differential.py tests/dodge/test_native_ga.py

checks.name: native_ppo_smoke
checks.command: DODGE_HEADLESS=1 UV_NO_SYNC=1 devenv -q shell -- app-test -q tests/dodge/test_ppo.py -k native
checks.scope: native backend selection and native PPO rollout smoke

checks.name: native_strict_gate
checks.scope: pinned rustfmt, locked Clippy, and nextest

harness_incidents.summary: A focused run invoked pytest directly and omitted the X11 library path owned by app-test, causing a false hidden-window timeout.
harness_incidents.resolution: The accepted focused and full-suite results use app-test.

harness_incidents.summary: The first visual comparison wrapper invoked bare Python and could not import the native NumPy dependency.
harness_incidents.resolution: The visual comparison wrapper now invokes uv with the native extra, and the packet completes with zero pixel mismatches.

harness_incidents.summary: The GA pattern replay found midpoint rasterization, static-pattern death, and terminal-input boundary defects that shorter fixtures did not exercise.
harness_incidents.resolution: The native renderer and game core now preserve Lua midpoint semantics, apply static-pattern death, and preserve the terminal simulation mask; the retained 562-frame pattern report is exact.
